out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: During sedative/bradycardia episodes in sleep, reports seeing the room and her sleeping husband “not with my eyes but with my soul,” with sleep paralysis; also during a later episode when “my heart stopped in sleep,” she saw the room and husband and a slightly open door with warm light.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Reports panic during sleep paralysis/bradycardia episode; no explicit separation sensations beyond paralysis/panic.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Mentions hearing a whisper “Jesus is near” and later interprets a circled cross as reassurance linked to Christ; no described visual encounter with Jesus.
arrival.other_being_detail: Imagined angels and white light healing husband during prayer (imagination during prayer, not an NDE realm encounter).

environment.environment_other_detail: Warm light streaming through a slightly open door during sleep episode; otherwise experiences described as interpretive synchronicities in ordinary environments (airports/plane/mall).

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Interprets a lit “Staff Only” door as God’s call to serve; later emphasizes helping others, praying for strangers, and avoiding harmful behaviors.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Two later episodes during sleep associated with sedative use for back pain and chronic bradycardia/possible cardiac arrest (“heart stopped in sleep”); plus a prolonged “three-day judgment” while alive during travel.

person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: States she had been an atheist for years prior to the experiences.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Reports prolonged synchronicity-based “judgment” in normal settings; later sleep episodes with paralysis, seeing room, and a door with warm light; also perceived light patterns from city lights answering thoughts during flight.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No classic NDE sequence; extensive life-review/judgment occurs while alive (airports/plane), later separate sleep episodes include threshold/door with warm light and abrupt return.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Judgment/life-review perceived as continuing across three days and recurring via sounds/smells/conversations; additional later sleep episodes with near-death sensations.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Describes consciousness “splitting”—one part functioning with husband while another perceived a deeper message/judgment layer.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Three-day “judgment” while fully alive with pervasive synchronicities; airport electronics malfunctioning; city lights forming responsive images; physical purging/vomiting as ‘purification’; later sleep episodes with door/threshold and warm light.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I experienced a three-day JUDGMENT while fully alive and conscious.”; “My consciousness seemed to split—one part of me stayed with my husband… while another part perceived everything beyond.”; “It was a judgement review of my life.”; “I want to LIVE.”; “Jesus is near.”; “I saw the room not with my eyes but with my soul.”; “Go to Him!”
